message: Scaled 2 of 4 spindle speeds to 110 %; 1 left as a variable or an expression, 1 left as a speed limit, 1 word for another spindle left as written (SB=).

findings.message: S2500 is a spindle speed limit (G50), so it is not scaled.
SB=2000 is the speed of a spindle with an address of its own, not the plain S word of the master spindle, so it is left as it is. Switch on "Also scale other spindles" to scale it with the others.
S=V2 is not a plain number, so it is not scaled.
